scenes.headline: WHAT IF THE SUN DISAPPEARED?
scenes.caption: Earth would not notice instantly. Light and gravity both take time to reach us.
scenes.narration: Earth would not notice instantly. Light and gravity both take time to reach us.

scenes.headline: SUNLIGHT TAKES TIME
scenes.caption: Light from the Sun travels for about eight minutes and twenty seconds before reaching Earth.
scenes.narration: Light from the Sun travels for about eight minutes and twenty seconds before reaching Earth.

scenes.headline: THE LAST 8 MINUTES AND 20 SECONDS
scenes.caption: After that delay, the final rays of sunlight would reach our planet.
scenes.narration: After that delay, the final rays of sunlight would reach our planet.

scenes.headline: EARTH'S ORBIT WOULD CHANGE
scenes.caption: Changes to the Sun's gravity would reach Earth at the speed of light.
scenes.narration: Changes to the Sun's gravity would reach Earth at the speed of light.

scenes.headline: EARTH WOULD START TO COOL
scenes.caption: Temperatures would fall gradually. Oceans would not freeze solid in a single night.
scenes.narration: Temperatures would fall gradually. Oceans would not freeze solid in a single night.

scenes.headline: A WORLD WITHOUT OUR STAR
scenes.caption: Our ecosystems and the flow of energy through life would be transformed.
scenes.narration: Our ecosystems and the flow of energy through life would be transformed.
